page.overview:
What is Halo On Fire?

Halo On Fire is the sixth song from Metallica's tenth studio album Hardwired...to Self-Destruct. It was written by James Hetfield and Lars Ulrich.

The song represents the fight inside a person between how they want to be seen as good (the halo) and the darker parts of themselves (the fire). It shows the struggles we face, like wanting things we shouldn't, and trying to look good while dealing with our own problems. This song is often linked to feelings of sadness or pretending to be something we're not. It's all about the clash between good and bad, keeping secrets, and the complicated feelings we go through when we face who we really are, which is shown through the changing music styles in the song.

Obey Obey Come won’t you stay Sincere Sincere All ends in tears Endure Endure Thoughts most impure Concede Concede But both shall we bleed

Oh, Halo on fire The midnight knows it well Fast, is desire Creates another hell I fear to turn on the light For the darkness won’t go away Fast, is desire Turn out the light Halo on fire
